title: Departure from Sinai and Wilderness Complaints

date.label: Narrative date: 20th day, 2nd month, 2nd year (Num 10:11)
date.note: Numbers 10:11 dates the departure from Sinai within the biblical narrative to the 20th day of the 2nd month of the 2nd year. That narrative date is not independently established as an absolute BCE date; no absolute year is inferred.

claims.claim: The received Numbers narrative contains the departure from Sinai and wilderness complaints material across Numbers 10–12.
claims.evidence: Numbers 10:11–12:16; biblical-text description, not independent evidence for an event date.
